assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness, raising concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and other unspecified cardiac arrhythmias.
A 48-hour ambulatory electrocardiographic monitoring study is indicated.
The CPT code 93226 represents this 48-hour Holter monitoring study.
The diagnosis codes are I48.91, I48.0, and I49.9.
The claim for CPT code 93226 has been denied.
The denial is based on Reason Code PR-204.
The service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan.
Appeals must be submitted in writing within ninety days of the date of this notice.
